raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Follow-up to #54284. `EncoderCacheManager.free_encoder_input` scans all of a request's other cached inputs on every call, so freeing a request with N multimodal items is O(N²) on the scheduler thread. This makes it O(N) with the same release semantics.

## Claims

- Freeing a request with N multimodal items is now linear in N: 1,024 items drops from 15.9 ms to 0.29 ms, and 4,096 from 235 ms to 1.2 ms.
- No behaviour change: an entry is still held until the request's last occurrence of that `mm_hash` is freed, as #54284 requires.
- Only matters for prompts with hundreds of items (the default limit is 999 per modality). Typical prompts see under 0.1 ms difference.

## Validation

`EncoderCacheManager.free(request)` timed on `main` vs this PR: 5 runs, median in ms, CPU only (CPython 3.12).

| Items per request | `main` | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| 256 | 1.36 | 0.09 |
| 1,024 | 15.87 | 0.29 |
| 4,096 | 234.64 | 1.21 |

`pytest tests/v1/core/test_encoder_cache_manager.py`: 22 passed (21 existing, including the duplicate-hash tests from #54284, plus 1 new). CI runs the file through `pytest -m cpu_test v1/core`.

I did not do a GPU end-to-end run. This only changes scheduler bookkeeping, so model outputs are unaffected.

## Details

The `any(...)` check added in #54284 runs on every free, so freeing N inputs costs N(N−1)/2 comparisons on the engine-core thread, and the whole batch waits. This PR keeps `request_hash_refs[req_id][mm_hash]`, a count of the request's cached input ids per hash, updated where `request_cached_ids` changes. The check becomes a dict lookup.

Tradeoff: one small dict per request. An out-of-tree manager that subclasses `EncoderCacheManager` and writes `request_cached_ids` directly would also need to update `request_hash_refs`.

---

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

@@ -445,6 +445,31 @@ def test_duplicate_mm_hash_is_not_evicted_before_last_use():
     assert manager.get_freed_mm_hashes() == []
 
 
+def test_many_inputs_release_each_hash_at_its_last_occurrence():
+    """A request with many items, one repeated, releases every entry exactly
+    once its last cached occurrence is freed."""
+    num_items = 64
+    hashes = [f"img{i}" for i in range(num_items)] + ["img0"]
+    manager = EncoderCacheManager(cache_size=num_items)
+    req = MockRequest("r1", hashes, [1] * len(hashes))
+
+    for i in range(num_items):
+        manager.allocate(req, i)
+    assert manager.check_and_update_cache(req, num_items)
+
+    manager.free_encoder_input(req, 0)
+    assert "img0" not in manager.freeable
+    for i in range(1, num_items):
+        manager.free_encoder_input(req, i)
+        assert manager.freeable[f"img{i}"] == 1
+
+    manager.free_encoder_input(req, num_items)
+    assert manager.freeable["img0"] == 1
+    assert manager.num_freeable_slots == num_items
+    assert "r1" not in manager.request_cached_ids
+    assert "r1" not in manager.request_hash_refs
+
+
 def test_encoder_decoder_cache_manager_reset():
     manager = EncoderDecoderCacheManager(cache_size=20)

@@ -86,6 +86,9 @@ def __init__(self, cache_size: int):
         self.num_embeds_by_hash: dict[str, int] = {}
         # request_id => set of input_ids cached for that request
         self.request_cached_ids: dict[str, set[int]] = {}
+        # request_id => mm_hash => number of that request's cached input_ids
+        # with the mm_hash
+        self.request_hash_refs: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
 
         # mm_hash of mm_data => num_encoder_embeds of the mm_data
         self.freeable: OrderedDict[str, int] = OrderedDict()
@@ -100,6 +103,7 @@ def reset(self) -> None:
         self.cached.clear()
         self.num_embeds_by_hash.clear()
         self.request_cached_ids.clear()
+        self.request_hash_refs.clear()
         self.freeable.clear()
         self.freed.clear()
         self.num_free_slots = self.cache_size
@@ -132,7 +136,7 @@ def check_and_update_cache(self, request: Request, input_id: int) -> bool:
             self.num_freeable_slots -= num_encoder_embeds
 
         self.cached[mm_hash].add(request.request_id)
-        self.request_cached_ids.setdefault(request.request_id, set()).add(input_id)
+        self._add_cached_input_id(request.request_id, input_id, mm_hash)
         return True
 
     def get_cached_num_encoder_embeds(
@@ -235,10 +239,20 @@ def allocate(self, request: Request, input_id: int) -> None:
         assert self.num_freeable_slots >= num_encoder_embeds
 
         self.cached[mm_hash].add(request_id)
-        self.request_cached_ids.setdefault(request_id, set()).add(input_id)
+        self._add_cached_input_id(request_id, input_id, mm_hash)
         self.num_free_slots -= num_encoder_embeds
         self.num_freeable_slots -= num_encoder_embeds
 
+    def _add_cached_input_id(
+        self, request_id: str, input_id: int, mm_hash: str
+    ) -> None:
+        cached_ids = self.request_cached_ids.setdefault(request_id, set())
+        if input_id in cached_ids:
+            return
+        cached_ids.add(input_id)
+        hash_refs = self.request_hash_refs.setdefault(request_id, {})
+        hash_refs[mm_hash] = hash_refs.get(mm_hash, 0) + 1
+
     def get_cached_input_ids(self, request: Request) -> set[int]:
         """Get all cached multimodal input IDs for a request."""
         return self.request_cached_ids.get(request.request_id, set())
@@ -257,10 +271,16 @@ def free_encoder_input(self, request: Request, input_id: int) -> None:
         mm_hash = request.mm_features[input_id].identifier
         # Always clean up request_cached_ids, even if the mm_hash was
         # already evicted from cache (e.g. by can_allocate).
-        if req_id in self.request_cached_ids:
-            self.request_cached_ids[req_id].discard(input_id)
-            if not self.request_cached_ids[req_id]:
+        cached_ids = self.request_cached_ids.get(req_id)
+        if cached_ids is not None and input_id in cached_ids:
+            cached_ids.remove(input_id)
+            hash_refs = self.request_hash_refs[req_id]
+            hash_refs[mm_hash] -= 1
+            if not hash_refs[mm_hash]:
+                del hash_refs[mm_hash]
+            if not cached_ids:
                 del self.request_cached_ids[req_id]
+                del self.request_hash_refs[req_id]
         # The mm_hash not in cache or the req_id set is empty
         if not self.cached.get(mm_hash, None):
             return

         # occurrence is freed: dropping it at the first makes the entry
         # evictable while the request still needs it, and the encoder then
         # recomputes an item it already has.
